title: spec/lang/<base>/welcome.json: the welcome tab's words in this base
description: Slice 22: the word the "Try hello" chip suggests, the question it starts, and the examples in the welcome tab's hints, all written in the base language. Never words to learn: the learner chooses every word.

ask_prefix.description: The start of a question the learner finishes with a language name, ending where they type: "how do you say hello in ".

no_ai_example.description: A word in another language with its meaning in this base: "hola = hello" for en, "hello = hola" for es.

example_question.description: A short question naming a target language: "hello in Japanese".

example_other_language.description: The same, naming another language a reader of this base might learn: "hello in Spanish".
